stories.claim: XPRIZE Wildfire finals run live near Nenana June 15-25; $11M competition, $3.5M grand prize; autonomous detect-and-suppress across 1,000 km2 in ten minutes; finalists include Anduril, Data Blanket, Dryad, FireSwarm Solutions, Wildfire Quest, AURA Foresight.

On June 22 an unauthorized drone was reported over the roughly 543-acre Starry Fire near Anderson, under evacuation orders issued June 21; FAA rules ban drones over wildfires because they can force aircraft to stand down.
GCI's only Aleutian subsea fiber was down nearly three weeks before a June 16 repair restored six communities; cause undetermined.
GCI is adding Starlink bonded-gateway failover, up to 10 Gbps per gateway, at Bethel, Sitka, Kotzebue, and Dillingham, first installs expected before year-end 2026.

SBA's proposed 8(a) overhaul preserves Alaska Native Corporation eligibility while eliminating the race-based social-disadvantage presumption for individually owned firms; comment deadline July 13, 2026.
